headline.title: Ferrari is using IBM’s AI to create F1 superfans
headline.summary: Ferrari is collaborating with IBM to enhance the fan experience in Formula 1 by leveraging AI technology. This partnership aims to create a more engaging and personalized experience for superfans of Scuderia Ferrari.

articles.title: Elon Musk has given up on solar power (on Earth)
articles.summary: Elon Musk's xAI has shifted its focus from solar power to natural gas, while SpaceX is concentrating on developing orbital data centers. This change raises questions about the future of Musk's vision for a solar-electric economy.

articles.title: Google’s new anything-to-anything AI model is wild
articles.summary: Google has introduced a new AI model capable of generating content across various formats, showcasing its versatility in transforming images and videos. This development highlights the potential for creative applications, including personalized storytelling and deepfake technology.

articles.title: Catch up on the Dialogues stage at Google I/O 2026.
articles.summary: At Google I/O 2026, Alphabet CEO Sundar Pichai participated in a discussion on the Dialogues stage, addressing key topics related to the company's vision and future initiatives. The event highlighted advancements in AI and technology, showcasing Google's ongoing commitment to innovation.

articles.title: AOP-Wiki EMOD 3.0: Data Model Expansions and Content Evaluation Framework for Using Agentic AI to Improve Integration between AOPs and New Approach Methodologies (NAMs)
articles.summary: The AOP-Wiki EMOD 3.0 introduces an expanded data model and a content evaluation framework aimed at enhancing the integration of Adverse Outcome Pathways (AOPs) with New Approach Methodologies (NAMs). This development supports the use of agentic AI to improve the understanding and application of in vitro and in silico methods in chemical regulatory assessments.

articles.title: Trace2Skill: Verifier-Guided Skill Evolution for Long-Context EDA Agents
articles.summary: Trace2Skill is a new framework designed to enhance hardware LLM agents' performance on Complex Verilog Design Problems (CVDP) by enabling them to effectively localize and edit relevant components within large repository snapshots. This approach focuses on improving agent capabilities at test time without the need for specialized model fine-tuning.

articles.title: S2ED: From Story to Executable Descriptions for Consistency-Aware Story Illustration
articles.summary: The article introduces S2ED (Story-to-Executable Descriptions), a framework designed to enhance multi-frame story illustration by converting narratives into editable executable descriptions. This approach aims to improve long-horizon coherence and consistency in character identity and layout across multiple images without requiring additional training.

articles.title: Search-E1: Self-Distillation Drives Self-Evolution in Search-Augmented Reasoning
articles.summary: The article discusses the concept of Search-E1, which utilizes self-distillation to enhance the capabilities of search-augmented reasoning agents post-training. It highlights recent advancements that improve performance by integrating external supervision and additional modules into the standard language model pipeline.

articles.title: Gated DeltaNet-2: Decoupling Erase and Write in Linear Attention
articles.summary: The article discusses Gated DeltaNet-2, a model that enhances linear attention by effectively decoupling the erase and write processes in memory management. It introduces a mechanism for editing compressed memory while maintaining existing associations, utilizing delta-rule models and Kimi Delta Attention to improve the efficiency of memory updates.

articles.title: CR4T: Rewrite-Based Guardrails for Adolescent LLM Safety
articles.summary: The article discusses CR4T, a new framework designed to enhance the safety of large language models (LLMs) in adolescent digital environments by implementing rewrite-based guardrails. This approach aims to provide constructive guidance rather than relying solely on suppression methods that can hinder meaningful interactions.

articles.title: Virtual 3D H&E Staining from Phase-contrast Back-illumination Interference Tomography
articles.summary: Researchers have developed a method for virtual 3D H&E staining using Back-illumination Interference Tomography (BIT), a phase microscopy technology that allows for rapid, non-destructive imaging of unprocessed tissues. This advancement aims to enhance disease management by enabling detailed volumetric characterization of tissue microarchitecture.

articles.title: Echo4DIR: 4D Implicit Heart Reconstruction from 2D Echocardiography Videos
articles.summary: Researchers have developed Echo4DIR, a framework for reconstructing 4D cardiac geometry from 2D echocardiography videos, addressing challenges of geometric ambiguity and temporal discontinuity. The method utilizes statistical shape models and a cardiac conditional signed distance function to enhance the accuracy of heart shape reconstruction.
